main_body: autumn tree with clustered red-orange foliage canopy and vertical brown trunk
top_band: upper lit canopy surface of orange-red foliage clusters (rows 1-25) sitting above the darker underside and trunk
evidence: Organic tree shows foreshortened overlapping foliage clusters viewed from above/front (rows 1-29) overhanging and casting deep shadow (rows 29-33) onto the vertical trunk (rows 31-45).

style.evidence: While the palette has 5-6 steps and dark material outlines, the foliage is drawn as smooth, rounded cotton-ball puffs with vertical banding on a straight cylinder trunk, lacking the crisp individual leaf-clump texture, visible inner branches, and gnarled root flares of the Beodeul reference trees.
